behaviour.indicator_definition_note: PROJECT_PLAN.md section 2.3 names savings rate/expense ratio/contribution rate, but FAR-Trans has no savings/expense data (decided explicitly with the user 2026-09-14). Indicators actually monitored: trading intensity (monthly trade count), contribution rate (monthly Buy value), asset-allocation mix (fed to Isolation Forest), and risk-category/investment-capacity snapshot changes.

risk_profile_snapshot_changes.finding: Zero raw-value changes found across all multi-dated FAR-Trans customers, verified directly (2,263 multi-dated customers, 0 with >1 distinct riskLevel or investmentCapacity value). FAR-Trans's multi-dated records do not represent genuine risk-category drift at the raw-value level — reported honestly rather than assumed to confirm PROJECT_PLAN's expectation.

expense.dataset_source: Kaggle primary (miadul/personal-finance-ml-dataset) — datasets/raw/kaggle/synthetic_personal_finance_dataset.csv. Characterizes the Kaggle population only; NOT linked to any FAR-Trans customer (synthetic assembly remains deferred).
expense.feature_note: emi_to_income_ratio is log1p-transformed — see training/expense/common.py docstring for the investigation that led to this (raw ratio produced a 587-row outlier-vs-rest split at k=2, not a genuine persona split).

ward.note: Ward evaluated (selection AND final artifact) on a random 5,000-row subsample — PROJECT_PLAN.md section 2.2 notes Ward is slow above ~10k rows.

expense.selection_method: silhouette comparison across each method's own best-k configuration
